g.text: Daemon Trust Boundaries on a Shared Host
Process lifetime decoupling, per-user socket permissions (0600), and isolated agent workspaces
Closing window does NOT stop PTY processes.
Pairing grants verified at gateway boundary.
No access to daemon socket or memory.
between distinct local OS user accounts.
Zero mid-upgrade disruption • No socket clash
Survives GUI reloads, crashes & sleep policies.
Exact replay proves zero missed bytes
What the daemon intentionally does NOT expose:
No direct arbitrary root privilege escalation
PTYs belong to the daemon, never the window.
GUI crash or window close leaves jobs alive.
Own git staging area & branch ref.
Agents cannot modify files outside target tree.
Shared bare repo objects stay clean
Attention counters indicate who needs input
